Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and the State.

2. This writ application has been filed for the issuance of a direction to the respondents to pay the compensation of land acquisition amount to the petitioner on revised and appropriate rate of compensation in view Patna High Court CWJC No.11714 of 2018(2) dt.12-01-2024 of Section 24(2)
of the right to Fair compensation and Transparency and Land Acquisition Rehabnilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (hereinafter to be referred as 'the Fair compensation Act, 2013) and furher Kapil Prasad And Anr vs The State Of Bihar And Ors on 12 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149647965/
1 for payment of compensation with interest and for making award upon multiplying four times of the present market value of the land.

entities.text: furher Kapil Prasad And Anr vs The State Of Bihar And Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. At the outset, learned counsel for the petitioner requests to dispose of the writ petition with direction to the (respondent No. 3), the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Sone Yojna, Daya Mukhya Canal Project, Aurangabad, Bihar to dispose of the representation, i.e.,. Annexure-2 of the writ petition, filed by the petitioner before him.

4. In view of nature of grievance of the petitioner, the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Sone Yojna,
Daya Mukhya Canal Project, Aurangabad, Bihar ( respondent No. 3 ) is directed to dispose of the aforesaid representation after hearing all the parties in accordance with the law, preferably within a further period of six Patna High Court CWJC No.11714 of 2018(2) dt.12-01-2024 months from the date of receipt/production of the copy of this order.

(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J) Koushik/-
